definitions.gloss: to beg; to implore; to plead earnestly
definitions.explanation: To ask someone for something repeatedly and persistently until they agree. Stronger than {頼|たの}む, implying that the requester is desperate or very persistent. The {込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of doing something thoroughly or intensely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{頼|たの}み{込|こ}んで⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I begged repeatedly and got permission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頼|たの}み{込|こ}んで、{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I begged my friend and got them to help me move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延|の}ばして→延ばす：28291_nobasu⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧よう、⟦{編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}→編集者：09587_henshuusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧で{頼|たの}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I desperately implored the editor to extend the deadline.

notes:
USAGE:
{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む is an intensified form of ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧. The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the meaning of doing something thoroughly, deeply, or persistently. The implication is that the request is not easily granted and requires repeated or heartfelt pleading.

Godan verb (む → ま/み/む/め/⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧): {頼|たの}み{込|こ}まない, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}みます, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}む, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}めば, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}もう

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む (to beg desperately)
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む (to beg again and again)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げて→下げる：00807_sageru⟧{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む (to bow one's head and plead)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頼|たの}み{込|こ}む: to beg, to implore (persistent, intense requesting)
- ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask, to request (neutral)
- ⟦{懇願|こんがん}する→懇願する：25407_kongansuru⟧: to entreat, to beseech (very formal)
- ⟦せがむ→せがむ：17931_segamu⟧: to pester, to nag (casual, often childish)
